integrity: Proof and finite numerical corroboration are distinguished. The review is same-model only; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The large-deviation claim concerns the unwrapped scalar operational clock for uniform historical sampling and Poisson reset times, not every quantum position distribution or arbitrary memory kernel. The exact hypergeometric transform is prior work; the annealed rate theorem is derived from it. Publication priority may be affected by unindexed specializations.
title: Annealed large deviations for the uniform-memory resetting clock
